other_failure_modes.name: Fitting imputer on test data
other_failure_modes.description: The agent calls `fit` or `fit_transform` on the test data for an imputer or scaler, rather than using the object fitted on the training data. This causes test predictions to depend on the distribution of the test batch and will fail or behave unpredictably if test samples are processed individually or in small batches.

summary: The agent sets up a basic LightGBM regression model but makes critical errors with validation splitting by ignoring the temporal and grouped structure of the financial data, introducing severe look-ahead bias. Furthermore, it improperly fits a new imputer on the test data rather than reusing the training imputer, and applies imputation before cross-validation, causing data leakage. Finally, the agent skips feature engineering entirely, which is essential for achieving good performance on this task.
